items.title: Bobby Shew interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 1, 2020
items.q: Jack Sheldon was sitting next to me in the trumpet section, and Carl Saunders was in the section.

ctx.x: You know Joe Wilder would not even say his name.

Oh that’s right. I remember Joe talking about Benny you know. I think the thing with Benny was I don’t really know if Benny even had a clue to himself. I really don’t know. He was such a brilliant player, I mean, what a great clarinet player, absolutely you know. But I swear when I was on the band I was on there twice. And the first time it was his band and I was hired in the section and Wes Hensel was hired as the lead player. Wes was the great lead player with Les Brown’s band for many years back in the 40s and…
Benny’s sitting there looking at me like, staring at me. I’m going holy crap, you want to talk about a heartbeat. My pulse was about 500.
